resolution: Reworked coastal-city transport generation to reject self-crossings, repeated road-pair crossings, shallow joins, clustered junctions, and over-degree nodes; fixed the SR-8 route ordering; taught native road planning to recognize diagonal junctions from true tangents; and replaced the retired minimap toggle with a live full-stage 2D city map backed by a compact native transport snapshot, batched site footprints, geography context, pan/zoom, and right-click 3D camera recentering. Targeted Zig and TypeScript tests plus the ReleaseFast editor build pass; visual and 60-second frame-time verification remain for the user.
